CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.Electric_Vehicle_Population_Ext
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'evpopulation/csv_to_parquet/',   -- folder to store parquet files
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_Ext_source,            -- linked storage name
    FILE_FORMAT =  external_parquet_file         -- external file format (Parquet)

    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://azuresynapse05.dfs.core.windows.net/externaldatasource/inputdata/Electric_Vehicle_Population_Data_1.csv',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',

    BULK 'inputdata/covid_tracking_1.json,

)

    [onVentilatorCumulative] VARCHAR(20),
    [recovered] VARCHAR(20),
    [death] VARCHAR(20),
    [totalTestResults] VARCHAR(20)
) AS rows;

FROM dbo.covid_tracking_ext_table;
